svg.font-family: Helvetica, Arial, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
svg.title: The map: eleven kinds of role and the ties between them
svg.desc: Drawn from the map's data alone. Each box is a kind of role and each arrow a kind of tie between two roles, heavier where more of the atlas's 183 dynamics speak of it; 19 ties are drawn and 38 thinner ones are listed on the page. Under each tie stand four squares, for begins, lasts, changes and ends. A filled square: a general law shows what makes it so. A square with a small mark inside: one built case alone shows it. An empty square: no law written up here shows it. A green dot marks a tie where a frozen prediction that got a verdict names a law on that tie; a green ring, one where a test with such a verdict bears on a dynamic that speaks of it. The marks count the drawn tie itself, not the thinner ones listed under it. A tie gathers laws of separate models that each name this kind of tie; an arrow is not a route, and nothing here ranks one place above another.
svg.text: a prediction with a verdict names a law here
a test with a verdict bears on a dynamic here
The four squares under a tie: begins · lasts · changes · ends. A heavier tie carries more dynamics. A tie gathers laws of separate models; an arrow is not a route.
